contract: wrkslots-config.json is the byte-identical tracked /.wrkslots.yml at source_commit; wrkslots-config.converted.yml is what agent-utils converter_commit wrote when run on a scratch copy of it, unedited
converter_setup_reason: the converter validates the whole configuration before writing and exits 3 without either: first 'configured worktrees directory is missing or unsafe' for worktrees_dir, then 'configured liveness command is missing, not runnable, or unsafe' for liveness_command (an empty, non-executable file satisfies it)
converter_command: PYTHONPATH=<agent-utils>/py python3 -m wrkslots --project-root <scratch copy> config convert --to yaml
converter_output: exit 0; rewrote <scratch copy>/.wrkslots.yml as the converted fixture and left the previous bytes, identical to the JSON fixture, in .wrkslots.yml.bak
